response.query: Which objective anchors or low-burden artifacts (short lesson logs, student work samples, brief video snippets) best validate teacher self-reports of 21st-century skill integration?
response.answer: Student work samples and brief video snippets best validate teacher self-reports of 21st-century skill integration. These artifacts provide concrete evidence of student engagement and learning outcomes.

results.title: SPS Policies - Stamford Public Schools
results.content: Within the bounds of its legal and ethical responsibilities, the Board of Education (Board) will. endeavor to inform the community about the operations of the school system by establishing. two-way communication with the community and involving citizens in the work of the schools. * Individual Board members who receive significant written communications from students, parents and other citizens, staff members, and organizations will give the communication to the Superintendent for dissemination to the entire Board. * The Superintendent will send copies of any communication addressed to the Board as a whole to each Board member. * The Board will not recognize anonymous written communications to any individual Board member or to the Board as a whole. * Individual Board members can express a personal opinion to a citizen but must clearly identify the opinion as their own and not necessarily that of the entire Board. * All actions of the Board affecting students, parents or teachers shall be communicated through the Superintendent of Schools.
